reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Alyssa Ravasio, co-founder and CEO of Hipcamp.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Alyssa Ravasio, co-founder and CEO of Hipcamp, a platform to discover and book your next camping trip. I was excited for this conversation as it combines two of my favorite passions – the outdoors and internet marketplaces. In our discussion, we cover how Alyssa bootstrapped demand in the early days of Hipcamp, the importance of creating not just great experiences but magical ones.

key_points.text: In our discussion, we cover how Alyssa bootstrapped demand in the early days of Hipcamp.
After listening to this episode, I’m sure the first thing you’ll want to do is get outside in nature.
Please enjoy my conversation with Alyssa Ravasio.
